fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the usage of tooling to sniff network traffic.
An adversary may place a network interface into promiscuous mode to passively access data in transit over the network, or use span ports to capture a larger amount of data.
fields.name: Network Sniffing - MacOs
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/tcpdump" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/tshark"))
